resources.string: Studio-grade mobile gaming broadcast & unified squad voice
Captures your voice for team voice rooms and YouTube Live commentary with real-time noise cancellation.
Displays a persistent live indicator, duration timer, and quick mute/stop controls while you game.
Shows a compact, movable live badge and control drawer over your games without leaving gameplay.
Requested by Android only when you tap Go Live. Captures gameplay video and internal game audio (Android 10+ where games permit).
Zro live never secretly records your screen or microphone. A persistent LIVE badge and Android status indicator are always visible whenever capture is active.
